_comment: Reviewed statements for scripts/gen_notices_pio.py (the ESP32-S3 / PlatformIO / Arduino-ESP32 image). Every entry carries a written reason. NOT legal advice.

lgpl_reviewed.reason: Arduino-ESP32 core (libFrameworkArduino): LGPL-2.1-or-later per the framework package (package.json) and the file headers; esp32-hal-* files carry Apache-2.0 headers. Statically linked: the LGPL-2.1 section 6 obligations apply (corresponding source, ability to relink).
Arduino-ESP32 library, LGPL-2.1-or-later (headers) with some Apache-2.0 files. Statically linked.
Arduino-ESP32 library, LGPL-2.1-or-later (headers); files without a header are treated as LGPL (conservative). Statically linked.
Arduino-ESP32 library, LGPL-2.1-or-later (header) next to Apache-2.0 files. Statically linked.
Arduino-ESP32 library; its file has no licence header, so it is treated as LGPL-2.1-or-later like the rest of the package (conservative). Statically linked.
Arduino-ESP32 library; its file has no licence header, so it is treated as LGPL-2.1-or-later like the rest of the package (conservative). Statically linked.
Arduino-ESP32 library; one file Apache-2.0, one without a header (treated as LGPL-2.1-or-later, conservative). Statically linked.

idf_copyleft_reviewed.label: GPL (header text)
idf_copyleft_reviewed.reason: hostap/wpa_supplicant files carry the old BSD/GPL-2 dual header ('Alternatively, this software may be distributed under the terms of BSD license'). The component's own COPYING/README state: previously BSD/GPL v2 dual, and since 2012-02-11 the project uses only the BSD licence. Used under the BSD option; checked by reading COPYING, README and one header. NOT checked file by file.

blob_note: Verified: the LICENSE file of each of these library folders is the plain Apache-2.0 text (sha256 cfc7749b96f63bd31c3c42b5c471bf756814053e847c10f3eb003417bc523d30 in ESP-IDF 5.5.5) and the folder README.rst/README.md says the binaries are 'provided under the same license as the parent esp-idf project - the Apache License 2.0 ... (The license text refers to this as "Object" form.)'. NOT verified: that Espressif's statement covers every third-party part inside the binaries, and no legal reading. The binaries are linked as shipped by the pioarduino framework-arduinoespressif32-libs package; their source is not available to us.
